items.prompt: Why place a unique sequence before a dictionary payload in a heap tuple?

options.text: It compares dictionary contents before the priority
options.why: Tuple comparison reaches later fields only after earlier fields tie. The unique sequence resolves equal priorities before dictionary payloads can be compared.

options.text: It silently deletes stale versions automatically
It makes all unsorted input streams sorted
options.why: A tie key does not repair stream order.
The distinct sequence resolves the comparison first.

items.explanation: The secondary key encodes a chosen tie order and keeps incomparable payload objects out of the ordering comparison.
